div.head: I Cn 5.2
div.ab: Gif man folciscne mæssepreost mid tihtlan belecge, ðe regollif næbbe, ladige hine swa diacon þe regollife libbe.
Gif man folchisne massepreost mid tihlan belegge, þe regollif næbbe, ladige hine swa diacon þe regollife libbe.
Plebeius sacerdos, qui regularem uitam non habet, purget se sicut regularis diaconus.
Gif man folciscne mæssepreost mid tihtlan belecge ðe regollif næbbe, ladige hine swa diacon þe regollife libbe.
Gif man folciscne mæssepreost mid tihtlan belecge, ðe regollif næbbe, ladige hine swa diacon þe regollife libbe.
Wenn ein laienhaft lebender Priester, der keine kanonische Lebensweise hält, mit Anklage belegt wird, so reinige er sich wie ein Diakon, der in kanonischer Lebensweise lebt.
If a secular priest who does not live according to a rule is charged with an accusation, let him clear himself like a deacon who lives according to a rule.
If an accusation is brought against a secular priest who does not live according to a rule, he shall clear himself in the same way as a deacon who lives according to a rule.
If an accusation is brought against one of the secular clergy who does not live according to a rule, he may exonerate himself as does a deacon who lives according to a rule.
